title: Part History entry wording with and without a note
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A], [Part-B] = tracked parts, active.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL WORDING A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WORDING-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WORDING-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL WORDING A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL WORDING B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WORDING-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-WORDING-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL WORDING B).
  5. Check the setup worked: both parts are on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, type the note "ZZAUTOTEST worn out" and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  2. On the Active tab search [Part-B], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  3. On the Inactive tab open [Part-B], pick "Active", Save, leave the note empty and click "Activate".
  4. On the Inactive tab open [Part-A], pick "Active", Save, type the note "ZZAUTOTEST restocked" and click "Activate".
  5. Open [Part-A]'s Part History and read its two newest entries.
  6. Open [Part-B]'s Part History and read its two newest entries.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: [Part-A] shows "Activated | Reason: ZZAUTOTEST restocked" and "Deactivated | Reason: ZZAUTOTEST worn out".
  • Step 6: [Part-B] shows "Activated" and "Deactivated", each with nothing after it (no "| Reason:").

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S10-R17, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.8 (Deactivated | Reason: …). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R17: “The entry reads "Deactivated" or "Activated". When the user gave a note it reads "Deactivated | Reason: {note}" or "Activated | Reason: {note}". With no note it reads "Deactivated" or "Activated" and nothing more.”
